J1.evidence: Unmarked additions confirmed: (1) source «وتبعه الجلال» → TR «Celâl (Mahallî/Suyûtî) de ona uymuştur» - the parenthetical «Mahallî/Suyûtî» is not in the Arabic (and is imprecise: this part of al-Jalalayn is al-Mahalli's); (2) verse «فصدقتها وكذّبتها» → «Ona [nefsime] doğru da söyledim» - «[nefsime]» is an interpretive supplement outside a Mütercim notu; (3) lughah «يعني أنها تصير شيئا كلا شيء» → «Yani (dağlar)…» adds the referent unmarked. Fix: move these into [Mütercim notu: …] or drop them. Otherwise TR is complete and faithful, and the source defects (ونفخ, المضي/المضارع, غير متناد, fused headings) are properly flagged in notes.

J2.evidence: Confirmed: (1) the verse فصدقتها وكذّبتها ... والمرء ينفعه كذابه is rendered 'Ona [nefsime] doğru da söyledim' — '[nefsime]' is not in the Arabic and is in plain brackets, not a Mütercim notu; (2) وتبعه الجلال → 'Celâl (Mahallî/Suyûtî) de ona uymuştur' adds an unmarked identification. Additionally Quranic words are transliterated in Latin: Abū Ḥayyān's الظاهر أنه متصل من قوله ولا شرابا → '"ve lâ şerâben" sözünden' and the reading كذابا → '"kizâben" şeklinde de okunmuştur' (also 'tekzîben' for تكذيبا); these must stay in Arabic script.

tr.fixed_note: Latin transliterations replaced by Arabic: futtihat (now 'teşdidle de okunmuştur' as in source), Ahkâb/ahkâb -> «الأحقاب», berd -> «البرد», el-Mefâz -> «المفاز»; al-Hasan's quoted ayah kept as «لابثين فيها أحقابا» and the paraphrase in point 2 uses «أحقابا» / «بردا ولا شرابا إلا حميما وغساقا»
